GoogleAnalyticsAnonymizeIP.description: Don't store last octet (or last 80 bits of IPv6 address) in Google Universal Analytics

GoogleAnalyticsOtherCode.description: HTML code for other web analytics (can be used along with Google Universal Analytics)

GoogleAnalyticsIgnoreNsIDs.description: Array with NUMERIC namespace IDs where web analytics code should NOT be included.

GoogleAnalyticsIgnorePages.description: Array with page names (see magic word {{FULLPAGENAME}}) where web analytics code should NOT be included.

GoogleAnalyticsIgnoreSpecials.description: Array with special pages where web analytics code should NOT be included.
